offering_description.value: Provides a cloud-based data collaboration platform that lets brands, agencies, publishers and platforms connect, unify and securely share customer data for marketing, measurement and analytics. Sells subscription access to identity resolution, clean-room and data-connectivity software to enterprises.

primary_products.value: data collaboration platform; identity resolution software; data clean room software; data connectivity software

primary_services.value: data onboarding and activation; implementation and professional services

customer_segment.value: B2B: brands, agencies, publishers, advertising platforms, retailers, financial and healthcare companies

end_markets.value: advertising and marketing; retail; financial services; healthcare; media and publishing

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring platform subscriptions for data collaboration and identity software; transaction or usage fees: usage-based fees for data activation and partner transactions; service fees: professional services and implementation
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud data collaboration and identity platform sold to enterprises, agencies and media partners

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: identity resolution, data clean rooms, data connectivity and activation tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to brands, agencies and publishers; partners / resellers: integrations with advertising platforms, cloud providers and publisher partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR, CCPA and other state privacy laws, plus FTC oversight
